lines: You cast trouble into the water. Now bring back something better.
An apology matters only if the harm stops with it.
I hear the words. I am waiting for the change.
You cannot mend this by pretending the tear was small.
Start by replacing what you broke.
I believe you regret it. I do not know yet if I trust you.
Give me time before asking for forgiveness.
Do not make the village pay for your anger again.
You hurt people who were not part of your quarrel.
A clean apology names what happened without excuses.
I can listen, but I will not make this easy for you.
Return what you took and we can speak again.
The water settles after a stone. The bank still remembers where it landed.
If you mean it, help with the repairs.
I would rather see one decent act than hear another speech.
You have a chance to do better. Use it.
Forgiveness is not the same as forgetting.
Tell the others too. I was not the only one harmed.
Keep your hands peaceful and your promises plain.
That is a beginning, not the end of making this right.
